_roster_doc: each slot is a unit line: its first age (`tier`), the building that trains it, its name on the tech tree page, and `last_age` when it stops before the last age. Slots with "status": "planned" are only on the page: the generator skips them (milestone 12). `upgrades`: false keeps the first unit for every later age (no second tier: the healer). `own_seed`: the line draws from its own random stream (prompt + slot), so adding it leaves every other line's recipes as they were

combat.shot_note: shots fly (combat.gd, shots.gd): milli-tiles a tick, shot_speed for bows, shot_speeds by the weapon's first tag that has one. A shot flies at the spot its target stands on, led by shot_lead_pct of the way it walks during the flight, and hits its target if its body still covers that spot (within shot_slack) when it lands, else the ground; with shot_strays 1 a miss may hit another foe of the shooter on the spot (off: shooting into a charging crowd then wastes shots, and massed archers no longer beat a mixed army at equal cost; tests/mass_battle.gd). Shooters fighting on their own skip a foe the shots in the air will kill.
combat.stance_note: stances (combat.gd): defensive units engage foes within defend_sight (or their reach, if longer) and give up once leash from where they stood, then walk back (leash stays above defend_sight, or they would turn back short of a foe that stands still).
combat.note: ticks at 20 Hz; distances in milli-tiles. Damage = max(min_damage, sum over attack classes the target has of max(0, attack - armour)).
combat.heal_note: healers (heal.gd): each one heals the most wounded unit of its own team (not itself, not animals, not buildings) within heal_sight, walking up to heal_range (edge to edge) when idle: heal_amount hp (x the unit's heal stat) every heal_reload ticks

movement.note: Movement classes (sim_map.gd CLASSES): a unit takes the first class whose tag it has, else ground. Terrains list which classes cross them (terrain.json move).

wonder.note: Wonder victory (src/sim/match.gd): a player whose Wonder is finished and stands for hold_seconds wins for their team; victory false turns it off (the Wonder is then just a monument)

fog.note: sight radii in tiles; the fog grid updates every `every` ticks (5 Hz)

trails.note: worn trails (src/sim/trails.gd, milestone 15): every `every` ticks each walking (not flying) unit wears its cell by `add` (up to `max`); every `decay_every` ticks every cell grows back by `decay`. A cell worn to `trail` is a trail: the view draws it, and walkers on it are `speed_pct` faster (0: off; the experiment in docs/milestones/m15-maps.md)

high_ground.note: high ground (src/sim/sim_map.gd heights, milestone 15): a shooter a level above its target reaches `reach` milli-tiles further, one below reaches that much less and deals `uphill_damage_pct` of its damage (arrows fall short; integers, no dice). Units see `sight_unit` tiles further per level they stand on, buildings `sight_building`. Ground above the viewer's level blocks sight past its rim (fog.gd).
